descriptions.long_en: Codex Blue Book is an independent guide for developers and product builders working with coding agents. Explore 13 chapters on setup, project rules, goal-driven development, testing, refactoring and product delivery. Read in Chinese or English, use the AGENTS.md protocol generator, browse the example projects and download both PDF editions. It is not an official OpenAI publication.
